description: Current per-token API prices for AI models, with context limits and official sources. The reviewed set (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) is human-reviewed and re-verified every few hours; the extended set (other providers) is parsed automatically from official pricing pages and marked verification "automated-page-parse". Only rows with state "current" have a confirmed price; held or expired rows show none.

current_only.description: Return only rows with a currently confirmed price.

include_automated_parse.description: Include extended providers parsed automatically from official pages (verification "automated-page-parse"). Default true.

model.description: Model id or name, e.g. gpt-5.4 or "Claude Opus 5.5". Omit to list all.

provider.description: Provider name, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek.

name: get_model_prices
title: Get AI model API prices
